translation.auth_desc: Browse every scheme without an account. Sign in only when you want to ask the AI for guidance.
translation.auth_free_1: Browse, search and filter all government schemes.
translation.auth_free_2: Open official application links without signing in.
translation.auth_err_pass_len: Password must be at least 6 characters.
translation.auth_confirm_msg: Account created. Check your email to confirm it, then sign in below.
translation.home_personalized_desc: Answer a few questions and Aadhikar AI will find the schemes you are eligible for.
translation.home_private_desc: Your documents and personal details stay on your device.
translation.schemes_subtitle: Government benefits you may be eligible for.
translation.schemes_none_desc: Try a different search term or category.
translation.chat_welcome: Namaste! I'm Aadhikar AI. Tell me a little about yourself — your state, age, occupation or family situation — and I'll help you find government schemes you may be eligible for.
translation.suggest_1: Which schemes am I eligible for?
translation.suggest_3: How do I apply for PM-KISAN?
translation.chat_disclaimer: Aadhikar AI can make mistakes. Verify details with official sources.
translation.chat_signin_title: Sign in to use the AI chatbot
translation.chat_signin_desc: Browsing schemes stays free. Sign in to ask Aadhikar AI about eligibility, benefits, and how to apply.
translation.voice_listening: Listening… speak now, then tap the mic to stop.
translation.voice_unavailable_hint: Voice input is unavailable in this browser or on this device.
translation.voice_err_unsupported: Voice input isn't supported on this device or browser. Please type your question instead.
translation.voice_err_insecure: Voice input needs a secure (HTTPS) connection. Open the app over HTTPS or localhost and try again.
translation.voice_err_permission: Microphone access was denied. Allow it in your device or browser settings and try again.
translation.voice_err_no_speech: I didn't catch that. Please try again and speak a little louder.
translation.voice_err_network: Speech recognition needs a network connection. Check your connection and try again.
translation.voice_err_language: Voice input isn't available for this language yet. You can still type your question.
translation.voice_err_audio: The microphone couldn't start. Close other apps using it and try again.
translation.voice_err_busy: Voice input is busy. Please try again in a moment.
translation.voice_err_generic: Something went wrong with voice input. Please try again.
